name: Beatport Remember
author: pedro
summary: Remembers your Beatport Streaming login and fills the login screen for you.
description: Remembers your Beatport Streaming login through the public AZ-MODS login service, then fills and submits it on the next login screen. Requires AZ-MODS 1.2.8 or newer and supported firmware. The core keeps credentials on the deck in /home/root/settings/azmod-community, readable by root only. The mod never receives the password.
